integrity: The proof gives an explicit affine permutation equivalence, performs the missing discriminant count in closed form, checks the enumerator sums to the full parameter-space size, derives dual coefficients by MacWilliams transformation, and includes independent direct reconstructions over GF(9) and GF(25).
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only the nondegenerate omitted cases of Theorems III.2 and III.5. It does not address the source's other two defining-set families or claim a classification beyond the explicit equivalence, enumerator, projectivity, and distance correction.
title: The omitted four-weight cases are equivalent and projective
